blocks.text: To celebrate the arrival of your “Favorites”, we are offering new subscribers a special discount until November 20th. With the promo code ODLPBOOKMARK26 and this link , you will benefit from a price of €59.00 for the first year, then €79.00 per year (regular price), with no long term commitment.

The Eye of Photography is more than 45,000 articles and more than 430,000 photographs , each one carefully selected by our team before being published. Enough to make wonderful discoveries every day… and to struggle to find them again afterwards. That is exactly what ‘Favoriyes” bookmarks are here to change.
Your Favorites © The Eye of Photography
How it works
One click to keep an article

On every article and every event in our listings, a small “Add to bookmarks” icon is waiting for you. One click and it’s saved. Right away, a window offers to file it straight into a collection , an existing one or a new one you create on the spot. No time to sort? Just click elsewhere: your bookmark is safely kept, and you can file it later.
Add to your Favorites © The Eye of Photography
Collections that look like you

“To read this weekend”, “Paris shows”, “Photo books to give”… Collections carry whatever names you give them , and a single article can belong to several of them. You can rename or delete them at any time.
Find everything, wherever you are

A small black button at the bottom left of the screen opens your list from any page of the site, and the My bookmarks page shows it in full. There you can filter your bookmarks by collection, by type (articles or events) and by section. And since everything is saved to your account, you find the same list on your computer and on your phone , as soon as you are logged in.
Category – Portfolios © The Eye of Photography
Category – Saul Leiter © The Eye of Photography
Three ideas to get you started

Plan your exhibition outings: You spot an exhibition in our listings, then another, then a festival at the other end of the country? Drop them into an “Exhibitions to see” collection. The day you have a free afternoon, your programme is already waiting.

Keep your reading for later: A long interview found on a Tuesday morning, a portfolio that deserves more than a glance between two meetings: one “To read again” collection, and you come back to them in peace, on Sunday, with a coffee.
Build your own photo library
A feature for our premium subscribers

Students, teachers, curators, picture editors or simply enthusiasts: gather, month after month, everything we publish about a photographer, a movement or a theme. Your own reference library , drawn from more than 45,000 articles.
Bookmarks are reserved for premium subscribers of The Eye of Photography. If you are not a subscriber yet, the “Add to bookmarks” icon will show you our offer: the perfect moment to join us.
And if your subscription expires, don’t worry: your bookmarks remain available to read for three weeks , giving you time to renew without losing a thing.
Discover our subscriptions
An idea that came from you, our readers

We did not dream this feature up alone in our corner. It was born from your messages , your suggestions and your repeated requests, sent by our most loyal readers over the years. You wanted a simple way to keep and organise what you love: we built it with you in mind, then had the whole editorial team test it before opening it to you.
An independent magazine, thanks to you

The Eye of Photography is an independent magazine , run by a small team of passionate people. No big media group behind us, no shareholders to please: just the desire, every day, to introduce you to the photographers, exhibitions and books that matter.

If this adventure goes on, it is thanks to our subscribers . Every subscription helps us stay free, keep our archives alive and develop tools like this one. Thank you, subscribers , for keeping the magazine alive. And thank you too, our everyday readers, who follow us, share us and write to us: you are the reason we do this work.
Help us make it better

Bookmarks are brand new, and they will grow with you. Subscribers, if you come across a bug, something odd, or an idea to make them even more useful, write to us at [email protected] . We read every message, and many improvements start exactly that way.
Happy discoveries, and happy collecting!
The team at The Eye of Photography
